porch_ceiling_surface_input_group.description: Rate per SF applies to net porch ceiling field area from PaintScope. Engine divides SF by rate to calculate hours. ALL base rates in this spec already include overhead work penalty (~25-35% reduction from vertical baselines). Do NOT apply FAC_PRCH_OVERHEAD as a separate stacking modifier.

task_production_rates.name: Porch Floor Protection
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Deploy canvas drop cloths and plastic on porch floor below ceiling work zone. ~14 sec per SF. Ground-level task — no overhead penalty. Faster than landscape protection (flat porch floor vs uneven landscape).

defect_tolerance.QT2: Key areas covered below working zone.
defect_tolerance.QT3: Full porch floor coverage. Secured against foot traffic.
defect_tolerance.QT4: Complete coverage taped at edges. Non-slip canvas on crew traffic areas.

task_production_rates.name: Porch Furniture Cover/Removal
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Cover or remove porch furniture items. ~7.5 min per item. Varies by size — rocking chairs faster, porch swings slower. Ground-level task.

defect_tolerance.QT3: All items fully covered or removed from porch.
defect_tolerance.QT4: All items removed. Full plastic coverage on non-removable items.

task_production_rates.name: Porch Ceiling Fixture Masking
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Mask porch ceiling fixtures overhead — ceiling fans (~10-15 min with blade removal), pendant lights (~5-8 min), recessed cans (~3-5 min). Average ~7.5 min per fixture. Slower than soffit fixtures (10 EA/hr) because porch ceiling fans are more complex to mask.

defect_tolerance.QT3: Complete coverage. Fan blades removed or fully masked.
defect_tolerance.QT4: Fan blades removed. All fixtures fully masked with clean tape lines.

task_production_rates.name: Fascia/Wall Junction Masking
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Apply tape and masking film along fascia-ceiling and wall-ceiling junctions when finished. Rate per SF of ceiling area (proxy for perimeter). ~7 sec per SF equivalent. Same rate as soffit fascia masking.

defect_tolerance.QT2: Tape at junctions. Film covers adjacent surface.
defect_tolerance.QT4: Precision tape line. Film fully covers adjacent surface.

task_production_rates.name: Brush/Roll Equipment Setup
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Stage brushes, rollers, trays, extension poles for overhead work. Set up ladders/scaffold. ~25 min per section. Same as soffit.

defect_tolerance.QT3: Fresh roller covers. Extension pole tested.
defect_tolerance.QT4: New roller covers. Premium brushes. Materials pre-mixed.

task_production_rates.name: Spray Equipment Setup
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Configure airless sprayer with 413-515 tip for overhead. Test spray pattern. ~45 min per section. Slightly less than soffit (50 min) because no vent verification needed.

defect_tolerance.QT3: Calibrated. Test pattern verified on cardboard.
defect_tolerance.QT4: Calibrated for overhead. Backup tips staged.

task_production_rates.name: Low-Pressure Wash Porch Ceiling
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Garden hose + soft brush overhead. ~10 sec per SF. Overhead penalty baked in (vertical 500-600, overhead 300-400). Same as soffit wash rate.

defect_tolerance.QT3: All dust, dirt removed. Allow 24 hr dry.
defect_tolerance.QT4: TSP/mildewcide wash. Allow 24-48 hr dry.

task_production_rates.name: Sand Wood Porch Ceiling
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: 80-120 grit sand on bare wood overhead. ~24 sec per SF. Overhead penalty baked in (vertical 200-250, overhead 120-180). Hand blocks for grooves, orbital for flat panels.

defect_tolerance.QT4: Full surface uniform scratch. All grooves inspected.

task_production_rates.name: Scuff Sand Fiber Cement Porch Ceiling
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: 150 grit light scuff on factory-primed FC overhead. ~20 sec per SF. Overhead penalty baked in (vertical 200-250, overhead 140-200).

defect_tolerance.QT4: Uniform scratch pattern across full surface.

task_production_rates.name: End-Seal Fiber Cement Cut Edges
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Brush sealer on each cut edge overhead. ~72 sec per edge. Overhead penalty baked in (ground 60-80, overhead 40-60).
task_production_rates.manual_capture_notes: Count of panel cut edges. Typical: 2-4 cuts per panel.

defect_tolerance.QT3: All edges sealed. No bare cellulose visible.
defect_tolerance.QT4: All edges sealed. Inspect for completeness.

task_production_rates.name: Spot-Prime Tannin Knots
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Brush stain blocker per knot overhead. ~3 min per knot. Same as soffit.
task_production_rates.manual_capture_notes: Count of visible tannin knots on bare cedar/redwood boards. Typical: 1-3 knots per 8 ft board.

defect_tolerance.QT3: All visible knots and sap streaks.
defect_tolerance.QT4: All knots. Inspect under bright light.

task_production_rates.name: Caulk Porch Ceiling Joints
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Apply and tool caulk overhead. ~65 sec per LF. Overhead penalty baked in (vertical 75-100, overhead 45-70). Same as soffit caulk rate.
task_production_rates.manual_capture_notes: Linear feet of panel joints and ceiling-to-trim junctions.

defect_tolerance.QT4: All joints. Consistent bead. Precision tool.

task_production_rates.name: Prep Dust Cleanup
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Tack cloth dust removal overhead. ~9 sec per SF. Overhead penalty baked in (vertical 500-600, overhead 300-500).

defect_tolerance.QT4: Pristine surface. Tack cloth verification.

task_production_rates.name: Prime Coat — Brush/Roll Overhead
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Brush for junctions and grooves, roller with extension pole for field. ~30 sec per SF. Overhead penalty baked in (vertical 150-200, overhead 100-150). Same as soffit.

defect_tolerance.QT3: Uniform coverage. Work into grooves. Maintain wet edge.
defect_tolerance.QT4: Uniform coverage. No lap marks. All grooves coated.

task_production_rates.name: Prime Coat — Spray Overhead
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Airless spray primer overhead. ~14 sec per SF. Overhead penalty baked in (vertical 300-450, overhead 200-300). Always eligible (no vent constraint).

defect_tolerance.QT4: Perfect uniformity. Raking light inspection.

task_production_rates.name: Prime Coat — Alkali-Resistant Brush/Roll Overhead (Bare FC)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Alkali-resistant primer on bare FC overhead. ~36 sec per SF. Slower than acrylic (bare FC is porous). Overhead penalty baked in.

defect_tolerance.QT4: Uniform. Consistent film build.

task_production_rates.name: Prime Coat — Alkali-Resistant Spray Overhead (Bare FC)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Alkali-resistant primer spray on bare FC overhead. ~18 sec per SF. Overhead penalty baked in.

defect_tolerance.QT4: Uniform. Inspect thin spots on high-absorption areas.

task_production_rates.name: Cut-In at Junctions — Coat 1

QT4.notes: Crisp, precise at 3 ft viewing standard.

task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Brush cut-in at fascia, wall, and column junctions overhead. Rate per SF (proxy for perimeter). Overhead penalty baked in.

defect_tolerance.QT4: Crisp, precise at 3 ft.

task_production_rates.name: Finish Coat 1 — Brush/Roll Overhead
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Roller with extension pole, brush for grooves. ~30 sec per SF. Overhead penalty baked in (vertical 150-200, overhead 100-150). Same as soffit.

defect_tolerance.QT3: Uniform. Consistent texture. Wet edge maintained.
defect_tolerance.QT4: Uniform. No roller marks at 6 ft.

task_production_rates.name: Finish Coat 1 — Spray Overhead
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Airless spray finish overhead. ~14 sec per SF. Overhead penalty baked in. Always eligible on porch ceiling.

defect_tolerance.QT3: Uniform mil build. No pattern at 6 ft.
defect_tolerance.QT4: Uniform. No pattern at 3 ft.

task_production_rates.name: Groove Brush-Back After Spray — Coat 1
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Brush into T&G/beadboard grooves overhead while spray coat is wet. ~24 sec per SF. Two-person operation. Same as soffit T&G brush-back rate.

defect_tolerance.QT3: All groove joints coated. Follow sprayer within 30-60 sec.
defect_tolerance.QT4: All grooves fully coated. No dry spots.

task_production_rates.name: Interstage Inspection
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Visual inspection overhead. Overhead penalty baked in (vertical QT3 1500, QT4 800).

defect_tolerance.QT3: Quick scan. Note runs, sags, holidays.
defect_tolerance.QT4: Systematic scan. All defects marked.

task_production_rates.name: Intercoat Light Sand — QT4 Only
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: 220 grit intercoat scuff overhead. ~20 sec per SF. QT4 only. Overhead penalty baked in (vertical 250-300, overhead 150-200).

defect_tolerance.QT4: Light uniform scuff. Remove nibs and drip marks.

task_production_rates.name: Interstage Touch-Up
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Brush touch-up overhead. Overhead penalty baked in (vertical QT3 2000, QT4 1000).

defect_tolerance.QT4: All defects repaired and blended.

task_production_rates.name: Intercoat Dust Removal
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Tack cloth after intercoat sanding overhead. ~9 sec per SF. QT4 only.

defect_tolerance.QT4: All dust removed. Surface clean for second coat.

task_production_rates.name: Cut-In at Junctions — Coat 2

QT4.notes: Crisp, precise at 3 ft. Final coat.

task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Second coat cut-in overhead. Same rates as coat 1 per tier.

defect_tolerance.QT4: Crisp, precise at 3 ft.

task_production_rates.name: Finish Coat 2 — Brush/Roll Overhead
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Same rate as coat 1. Consistent surface from first coat. Final appearance coat.

defect_tolerance.QT4: Uniform. No roller marks at 3 ft.

task_production_rates.name: Finish Coat 2 — Spray Overhead
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Same rate as coat 1. Final appearance coat.

defect_tolerance.QT4: Uniform. No visible pattern at 3 ft.

task_production_rates.name: Groove Brush-Back After Spray — Coat 2
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Same rate as coat 1. Final coat — all grooves fully coated.

defect_tolerance.QT4: All grooves fully coated. No missed grooves.

task_production_rates.name: Final Walkthrough Inspection

QT2.notes: Ground-level scan for misses and drips.

task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Final walkthrough of completed porch ceiling. Overhead penalty baked in.

defect_tolerance.QT3: No defects at 6-10 ft. Grooves covered.
defect_tolerance.QT4: No defects at 6 ft. Coverage uniform.

task_production_rates.name: Final Touch-Up
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Brush touch-up overhead. Overhead penalty baked in.

defect_tolerance.QT4: All defects repaired. Blended seamlessly.

task_production_rates.name: Protection Material Removal
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Remove floor drop cloths, furniture covers, masking tape/film, fixture masks. Restore furniture. ~10 sec per SF. Ground-level task.

defect_tolerance.QT3: All removed. No tape residue. Furniture in original positions.
defect_tolerance.QT4: All removed. Check for paint transfer. Furniture restored.

task_production_rates.name: Clean Equipment
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Clean rollers, brushes, extension poles. Flush sprayer if used. ~30 min per session.

defect_tolerance.QT4: Full flush. Equipment ready for next use.

task_production_rates.name: Site Debris Cleanup
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Collect debris. Final porch walkthrough. ~20 min.

defect_tolerance.QT4: Porch restored. Walkthrough with customer.

factor_modifiers.name: Access Type Modifier
factor_modifiers.description: Access type drives production rate reduction for elevated work.
factor_modifiers.notes: Applied per elevation. Ground tasks (floor protect, furniture protect, fixture mask, equipment setup, cleanup) are ground-level and not affected. Base rates already include overhead penalty.

factor_modifiers.name: T&G / Beadboard Joint Complexity Modifier
factor_modifiers.description: T&G and beadboard have groove joints requiring brush work. 20% time increase.
factor_modifiers.notes: 20% time increase for T&G and beadboard. Groove brush-back tasks (TSK_PRCH_GROOVE_BRUSH_BACK_1/2) already reflect groove work — do NOT apply this modifier to those.

factor_modifiers.name: Quality Tier Production Modifier
factor_modifiers.description: Quality tier affects pace on qt_scaled tasks.
factor_modifiers.applies_to: qt_scaled tasks only (TSK_PRCH_CUTIN_JUNCTIONS_1, TSK_PRCH_CUTIN_JUNCTIONS_2, TSK_PRCH_INSPECT_COAT, TSK_PRCH_TOUCHUP_REPAIR, TSK_PRCH_FINAL_INSPECT, TSK_PRCH_FINAL_TOUCHUP)

quality_effects.notes: Economy. Single finish coat. Minimal inspection.
Standard. Two finish coats. Interstage inspection.
Premium. Two coats. Intercoat sand 220 grit. Systematic inspection.

overhead_rate_design_notes.rationale: All base rates reflect overhead penalty (~25-35% reduction from vertical baselines). FAC_PRCH_OVERHEAD (1.35 from research) is NOT applied as a stacking modifier. Same design as soffit spec.
overhead_rate_design_notes.stacking_with_access: FAC_EXT_ACCESS stacks on top of overhead-adjusted base rates.

assumptions: Base rates include overhead penalty. Do NOT apply FAC_PRCH_OVERHEAD as stacking modifier.
Modifier stacking cap: 4.0x. Worst case: T&G + scaffold = 1.92x (well under cap).
Spray always eligible — no vent type gating (key difference from soffit).
Groove brush-back tasks already reflect groove work — FAC_PRCH_PANEL_JOINTS does NOT apply to those.
Ceiling fan masking is slower than standard fixture masking (~7.5 min vs ~6 min per fixture).
Protection setup/teardown, equipment setup, and cleanup are ground-level tasks.
crew_size = 1 for all tasks except groove brush-back on spray.
risks: Beadboard modifier (1.20x) assumed equal to T&G — may need calibration.
Ceiling fan masking time varies significantly by fan complexity.
T&G + scaffold (worst case 1.92x) is slow but within cap.
Overhead spray rates may need field calibration — limited data for porch ceiling spray.
validation_plan: Time 3 brush/roll projects on smooth solid panel porch ceiling at ground/ladder.
Time 2 beadboard porch ceiling projects to validate 1.20x modifier.
Time 1 spray project to validate 250 SF/hr overhead rate.
Compare ceiling fan masking time to standard fixture masking.
